wake_prompt: [LA_WAKE] Continue the active goal from current bound-repository evidence. Inspect only the state and exact run/result needed for the next decision; do not queue duplicates or recap unchanged state. For healthy Local Agent work, do not poll it at 30-second cadence: recheck no sooner than at least 2 minutes and normally use 5-10 minutes for multi-minute builds/tests.
